title: Godot Editor crashes on Android when creating a ShaderMaterial in a 2D project
body:
### Tested versions

Godot version: 4.7.2 stable
Platform: Android
Device: POCO M7 Pro
Renderer: GL Compatibility
Editor: Godot Android Editor

### System information

I am developing a 2D game using the Godot Android Editor version 4.7.2 stable on a POCO M7 Pro.  When I try to create a ShaderMaterial by clicking the Material property of a 2D node, the Godot Editor immediately crashes and closes.  After restarting the editor, my project opens normally. The crash only occurs when I try to create a ShaderMaterial.  I want to use a shader for my 2D game's title screen.  Expected behavior: The editor should allow me to create a ShaderMaterial without crashing.  Actual behavior: The editor crashes immediately when I click to create a ShaderMaterial.  Steps to reproduce: 1. Open a 2D project in the Godot Android Editor. 2. Select a 2D node. 3. Open its Material property. 4. Try to create a new ShaderMaterial. 5. The editor crashes and closes.  I have not determined the exact cause of the crash.

### Issue description

1. Open a 2D project in the Godot Android Editor.
2. Select a 2D node in the scene.
3. Find the Material property in the Inspector.
4. Tap the Material property.
5. Select ShaderMaterial.
6. The Godot Editor immediately crashes and closes.

### Steps to reproduce

The same crash also occurs in my older 2D project.

This suggests that the issue may not be specific to my current project.
